regimens.dose_text: Mild to moderate AD: Initial dose is 5 mg once daily at bedtime. May increase to 10 mg once daily after 4 to 6 weeks. Severe AD: 10 mg once daily; may increase to 23 mg once daily after at least 3 months on 10 mg daily. Take with or without food. Monitor for symptomatic bradycardia and syncope.

refs.quote: A dose of 23 mg per day should not be administered until patients have been on a daily dose of 10 mg for at least 3 months. 2.3 Administration Information ARICEPT should be taken in the evening, just prior to retiring.

regimens.dose_text: Administer 23 mg orally once daily at bedtime in patients with moderate to severe Alzheimer's disease who have been established on a stable dose of 10 mg once daily for at least 3 months. Swallow tablet whole with liquid; do not chew or crush.

refs.locator: Section 7.2 Use with Cholinomimetics and Other Cholinesterase Inhibitors
refs.quote: A synergistic effect may be expected when cholinesterase inhibitors are given concurrently with succinylcholine, similar neuromuscular blocking agents, or cholinergic agonists such as bethanechol.
